errors.text_span: Visually, the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size when moving counter-clockwise from the right side of the chart.
errors.evidence: The description states the segments are arranged in descending order when moving counter-clockwise from the right side. However, the sequence of values starting from the right ('Article editing') and moving counter-clockwise is 4.1%, 12.8%, and 83.1%, which is an ascending order, not descending.
